purpose: Release qualification receipt for native inactive-route handling in B12X dynamic MoE kernels

change_contract.implemented: B12X dynamic MoE kernels ignore route identifiers below zero or outside the expert range and skip producer-side quantization and route fanout for tokens without an active expert route.
change_contract.compatibility: Valid expert routes retain their existing arithmetic. VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING=1 remains enabled by default and VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING=0 remains an explicit compatibility override.
change_contract.superseded: vLLM pull request #291 is excluded because assigning inactive rows to expert zero is correct but performs unnecessary expert-zero work. B12X pull request #214 consumes the inactive-route contract directly.

source_validation.b12x_gpu_tests: pass: 29 tests across dynamic Trellis, W4A8 dynamic, and standard MoE corpora
source_validation.compose_validation: pass: DeepSeek and three GLM release profiles
source_validation.release_audit: pass: every open vLLM, B12X, and LMCache pull request classified
source_validation.source_composition: pass: immutable integration locks with empty source_patches arrays
source_validation.image_source_contract: pass: B12X pull request #214 present and vLLM pull request #291 absent

pre_release_ab_validation.candidate_scope: B12X pull request #214 at 321c24a7ef60174cd6131d932f43bb84a4f3a60f with vLLM pull request #291 removed

result: B12X pull request #214 provides the inactive-route contract required by VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING=1 without routing padding rows through expert zero. The source test suites, clean source composition, published image, full CUDA graphs, target-only decode, DSpark K5 decode, and arithmetic content probe passed.
limitations: Published-image runtime validation covers TP2/DCP1 with native KV offload and LMCache disabled.
The pre-release C4, C8, and prefill results isolate B12X pull request #214 on the r14 source composition; the published r15 image received a separate C1 and correctness gate.
DSpark aggregate throughput is trajectory-dependent and must not be compared without matching prompts, sampling, and acceptance accounting.
GLM launch contracts passed statically; GLM checkpoints were not loaded for this receipt.
